context_only: # tp v0.31.1 — Close the v0.31.0 gaps
### 2.1 Enable a formatter in the repo lint config
### 2.2 Fix the recommended-gate guidance in the docs

tasks.title: Enable gofmt in the lint config with a guard test
tasks.acceptance: The repo .golangci.yml has a formatters section enabling gofmt, so golangci-lint run reports a gofmt-dirty file and exits non-zero. A deterministic Go test reads .golangci.yml and asserts its formatters section enables gofmt, so silently dropping the section fails the test. The existing linters and their settings are unchanged.
source_sections: ## 2. Quality gate: close the gofmt blind spot
tasks.closed_reason:
- .golangci.yml gained a formatters section enabling gofmt (.golangci.yml:29-31); verified empirically that golangci-lint run now reports a gofmt-dirty file and exits non-zero (was 0 issues before)
- TestGolangciConfigEnablesGofmt reads .golangci.yml, parses it with yaml.v3, and asserts formatters.enable contains gofmt — fails if the section is dropped (internal/cli/golangci_config_test.go); passes now
- The existing linters block and settings are untouched; the change only adds the top-level formatters section, and the whole repo is gofmt-clean so golangci-lint run stays at 0 issues

tasks.title: Fix the recommended-gate guidance in the docs
tasks.acceptance: CLAUDE.md, README.md, and skills/tp/SKILL.md that recommend the go test plus golangci-lint run gate note that golangci-lint v2 runs formatters only when a formatters section enables them, so a gofmt check must be enabled (or gofmt -l added) for the gate to catch formatting. tp does not change the default gate string tp init authors.
source_sections: ## 2. Quality gate: close the gofmt blind spot
tasks.closed_reason:
- README.md (quality_gate bullet), CLAUDE.md (Quality gate after every task), and skills/tp/SKILL.md (Quality gate command) each now note that golangci-lint run (v2) checks formatters like gofmt only when a formatters section enables them, so one must be enabled in .golangci.yml (or gofmt -l added to the gate) for the gate to catch formatting
- The advisory text does not change the default gate string tp init authors; the quality_gate stays user-authored and read-only

tasks.title: Hoist review_converge_on in tp config --extract
tasks.acceptance: computeCommonPolicy treats review_converge_on as common when every override sets it to the same value using the all-equal-string logic and not when values differ or any file leaves it unset. hoistedFields appends review_converge_on to the deterministic hoisted list when common sets it. mergeCommon copies a non-nil common review_converge_on into the project override while preserving other hand-set project fields. Tests cover hoist-when-all-equal, not-hoisted-when-divergent-or-partially-unset, and mergeCommon preservation. commit_strategy is not hoisted per Non-Goal 1.
tasks.closed_reason:
- computeCommonPolicy: added an all-equal-string block for ReviewConvergeOn (mirrors quality_gate) — common only when every override sets it to the same value, nil when divergent or unset in any file (config_extract.go:56-68)
- hoistedFields: appends "review_converge_on" to the deterministic list when common.ReviewConvergeOn != nil (config_extract.go)
- mergeCommon: copies a non-nil common.ReviewConvergeOn into dst, preserving other hand-set project fields (config_extract.go)
- Tests: TestComputeCommonPolicy_HoistsUnanimousReviewConvergeOn, _ReviewConvergeOnNotHoistedWhenDivergentOrAbsent (divergent + partially-unset), TestMergeCommon_WritesReviewConvergeOn (preserves AuditMaxRounds) — all pass
- commit_strategy left out of all three helpers per Non-Goal 1 (read-only per task)

tasks.title: Report review_converge_on drift in tp validate --project
tasks.acceptance: workflowDeviations reports a deviation when a task file review_converge_on override and the project review_converge_on are both set and differ using the both-set string comparison. A field the project does not set is not a deviation. Under --strict a review_converge_on deviation is a validation error exiting 1. Tests cover differ-to-deviation, --strict exit 1, and equal-or-project-unset yields no deviation.
tasks.closed_reason:
- workflowDeviations: added a both-set string compare for ReviewConvergeOn (mirrors quality_gate) — reports {field:review_converge_on, override, project} when both are set and differ (validate_project.go:36-38)
- A review_converge_on the project does not set yields no deviation (both-set guard); verified by the project-unset test case
- --strict is field-agnostic: runValidateProject exits ExitValidation (1) whenever len(deviations)>0, so a reported review_converge_on deviation trips --strict exit 1 through the existing generic path
- Tests: TestWorkflowDeviations_ReviewConvergeOn covers differ→deviation (all vs blocking), equal→no deviation, and project-unset→no deviation — all pass
